semantic_reason_registry.normative_condition: The named one-dimensional ordered pre-owner parse, canonical, structural, consensus, chain, fee, DA-identity, or integrity check rejects and no narrower reason applies.
Either an outer local lifecycle gate returns before any domain entrypoint, or the selected detached DA owner entrypoint returns unavailable before pending-outpoint reserve.
The exact shared-owner reservation finds the input already owned by the other retained domain.

An exact replay or different DA_COMMIT transaction duplicates an already-retained commit for the same da_id and rejects before shared-owner reservation; REMOTE_P2P has the existing negative duplicate-commit peer-quality effect and LOCAL_RPC returns HTTP 409.
CB18.5 step 8 cannot preallocate or preflight one exact final result before the final DA lock.
The completing candidate loses the exact CB18.4 comparator, including equality.
The post-reservation final exact live image or token recheck differs from the planned snapshot.
A selected resident record or its accounting fails required integrity before capacity publication.
A selected victim lacks a required member, locator, or claim.
Configured DA mempool bytes are outside 536870912 through 4294967295 and startup rejects.
The next accepted sequence would exceed u64 max before mutation.
The relevant bound source mandates fail-closed INTERNAL for malformed or inconsistent retained owner, index, or accounting evidence and no narrower reason applies.
